lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Multiple columns of high-luminance, roughly circular pixel clusters arranged in a semi-regular grid posterior to the branchial region.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with horizontal rows of high-luminance blobs, forming grid-like anchor nodes along the mid-lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct horizontal linear features on the upper flank exhibiting a sharp vertical gradient with high-intensity luminance on the dorsal edge and localized shadowing on the ventral edge.
